question: T108.csv holds 10 consecutive measurements (column frame_index 0-9) whose baseline drifts over time. Quantify the drift as the linear regression slope of the median intensity per frame, and state whether it is increasing or decreasing.
answer_text:
The analysis of the file `T108.csv` was performed to determine the drift in baseline intensity over a sequence of 10 frames (indices 0-9). For each frame, the median intensity across all recorded Raman shifts was calculated. A linear regression was then performed on these median values against their respective frame indices.

The resulting slope is approximately **17.99**, which indicates that the baseline intensity is increasing as a function of time/frame count.
